plan.title: Verify ._ AppleDouble resource forks are excluded from library scanning

narratives.Overview: An attached volume held 3,925 files matching video extensions, of which 1,824 (46%) were macOS ._ AppleDouble resource forks - zero-content stubs created when writing to a non-native filesystem.
narratives.Problem:
It is NOT currently known whether the library scanner excludes them. If it does not, the library may be counting, fingerprinting and generating thumbnails for ~1,800 phantom files.

This is an observation, not a diagnosis. Verify before changing anything.
narratives.Action: Determine whether LibraryScanner filters ._ prefixed files. If it does, close this and record the finding. If it does not, add the exclusion and assess whether existing libraries carry phantom asset rows needing cleanup.
narratives.Constraint: If phantom rows already exist, removing them is a data change and needs its own decision - do not delete rows as a side effect of fixing the scanner.
narratives.Risk: Low to verify. If phantom rows exist, cleanup is the riskier half and should be separated.
narratives.Test:
T8 - ._ AppleDouble files are never treated as videos.
If cleanup is needed: a test that removal targets only zero-content stubs and never a real asset.
narratives.Source: Spec, incidental finding. Measured 2026-08-03 on an attached ExFAT volume.

items.title: Determine whether the scanner excludes ._ files
If not, add the exclusion with a test
Assess whether existing libraries hold phantom asset rows
If they do, file cleanup separately
